A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have shown that the TFLK motif of M-SAA is responsible for the up-regulation of the intestinal mucin gene MUC3 and that the M-SAA TFLK motif is also responsible for the inhibition of enteropathogenic E. coli (EPEC) binding to the MUC3 expressing HT29 cells.

a peptide derived from the N-terminal region of MSA-3 is capable of up-regulating the expression of MUC3 mucins.
